differences_from_v1: Majority per case replaces case-repeat counts for future selection; raw repeats remain reported.
Separate expert-unit DISCARD, terminal-noise KEEP, mixed harm and expert action match; explicit tolerance and stability gates.
Maximum three rounds including completed historical round 1; ablation then combined-candidate confirmation.
Campaign-wide budget, frozen observations/skills, correction audit and all-run rescoring.
No retrospective preregistration claim or overwrite of historical scoring/results.
scope: 35 targeted, dependent development cases; diagnostic only, not independent benchmark or statistical equivalence evidence. Historical three-view and four-view expert observations remain stratified.

original_cases.additional_cases: Separate group only, excluded from original-35 winner selection; freeze group IDs and hashes before each round.

voting.majority: strictly more than half of planned repeats
voting.consistency: modal count / planned repeats; distinct from v1 pairwise consistency
voting.ties: Count separately, no substituted action; also report unique plurality without strict majority.
voting.incomplete_or_unstable: Keep original denominators and unresolved counts; report observed diagnostics only. Any unresolved original case in either compared version blocks winner selection; no automatic extra repeats.
voting.unstable_label: 结果不稳定，不据此下结论

selection.winner: Complete stable pairs only. Candidate wins if either pure_expert_discard or pure_noise_keep decreases by >=2, OR expert_correct increases by >=2; in ALL cases neither pure risk nor mixed_harm may increase by >1, and expert_correct may not decrease by >1. Apply symmetrically to baseline. Otherwise no winner; opposing >=2 effects are a tradeoff, not equivalence.
selection.tolerance_note: One case is an operational tolerance, NOT proof of no harm or statistical equivalence; +1/7 expert-unit DISCARD is +14.3 percentage points and must remain visible.
selection.fallback: v0 if no eligible reviewed winner
selection.manual_review: Numeric eligibility is not final approval. A reviewer must approve regressions before adoption; unreviewed candidates are not fallback winners.

historical_round_1.conclusion: v1 failed original v1 preregistration; this routes to ablation, not a v2 majority/stability verdict. Any rescoring is retrospective supplementary analysis.

round_2.design: Each candidate = v0 plus exactly one documented change. Shared newly repeated v0 arm in this round. No new hypotheses mid-round.

round_3.design: Combine only individually eligible and reviewed improvements; freeze their identities and diffs. Compare against a newly repeated v0 arm.

rounds.stop_if_no_single_winner: Freeze v0; report: 在这批用例上，修改领域规则没有带来改善，下一步应优先检查 controller、画图和数值观测。 Only use this conclusion after complete stable testing, not after budget/error/instability stops.
rounds.fallback_order_note: Administrative preregistered tie-break, not evidence S1 is superior. If combined is not reviewed/eligible, use first reviewed eligible single candidate; if none use v0.

budget.scope: Only future rounds 2 and 3; historical charges and unresolved historical reservation excluded and disclosed separately. Prior authorizations do not carry over.
budget.start_gate: User-filled finite positive cumulative cap required. Stop if cumulative settled charges + unresolved reservations + whole-round conservative estimate exceeds cap. An estimate or offline manifest is not inference authorization.
budget.stop: No partial round start to use remaining funds; runtime reserve-before-call still required by a separately authorized executor.

freeze.after_start: Reject any changed frozen file. No provider or execution entrypoint is added by this scoring implementation.
freeze.stage45: New stage4/5 observations are not mixed into this original-35 campaign. Any such experiment is separate.

correction_policy.application: Create a new immutable scoring revision, never mutate audit_cases. Rescore EVERY registered round/version with the same cumulative correction ledger into a new output directory. Keep original reports and responses; never apply only to later versions. The complete campaign inventory, including historical round 1, is required.
correction_policy.not_allowed: Changing case membership, images, votes, or standards merely to match a preferred model. Corrected labels do not create independent validation.

report.decision_change_count: Compare resolved strict-majority actions for each paired case; denominator and unresolved pairs separately listed.
report.small_effect_label: skill 改动对决策影响很小
attribution_categories: 模型理由没有用到新规则
证据不足／多因素，待复核
report.default_attribution: 证据不足／多因素，待复核
report.attribution_policy: Include ALL repeat rationales verbatim for both versions. Categories are human hypotheses unless evidence is verified. Omission in a rationale does not prove a rule was unused; disagreement does not prove a wrong label. Never automatically correct labels from model text.
